The '''Parada system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hadar sector/Legends|Hadar sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Parada]].
